release_name: Live TV v5.3.4 (Build 66) — 3-Platform Microservices Architecture & High-Resilience CDN
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🏗️ 3-Platform Microservices Architecture: Complete decoupling of shared Web core, macOS native app, and Android native app into modular microservices with single-responsibility domains.
🍏 macOS Native Decomposition: Modularized into WindowController, WebViewController, NativeBridgeHandler, AppUpdaterService, and RemoteControlService.
🤖 Android Native Architecture: Decoupled NativeBridgeService, WindowModeService (PiP / Immersive Sticky), and KeyNavigationService for TV D-pads.
🌐 Web Core Microservices: Dedicated services for StreamEngine, Catalog, SportsTelemetry, AIUpscaler, AudioDSP, Update, and Storage.
🏎️ Dedicated MotoGP Feeds: Verified Dorna MotoGP Official World Feed FHD, FanCode 1 FHD dedicated motorsport feed, and TNT Sports 2 HD with zero crosstalk.
🏏 Willow Sports Multi-Server Failover: Upgraded Willow Cricket HD to 24/7 enterprise Amazon AIV-CDN streams with dual ClearKey servers and BDIX fallback.
⚽ beIN Sports 1, 2, 3 & XTRA Enterprise Overhaul: Replaced expired links with verified 24/7 Amazon AIV-CDN DASH feeds and Amagi FAST fallbacks.
🏎️ Sky Sports EPL, Racing & Action Restored: Added verified high-resilience streams for Sky Sports Premier League, Sky Sports Racing, and Sky Sports Action.
